mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ires.result_qty), 0) FROM inbound_results AS ires WHERE ires.inbound_schedule_id = #{inboundScheduleId} AND ires.company_id = #{companyId};
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inbound_results( company_id, inbound_schedule_id, result_qty, result_date ) VALUES( #{companyId}, #{inboundScheduleId}, #{resultQty}, #{resultDate} )
